items.label: Adjustable Size
items.value: 11 in x 11 in x 70.87 in, adjustable height from 35 to 70 in, with 4 height options for 100% control over plant growth direction. A garden obelisk trellis improves your garden.

items.label: Why Choose Us
items.value: Laodier trellis compared to other plastic crossbars, which can easily tip over and fracture, our metal crossbars provide greater stability. Additionally, square prisms offer more growing space compared to cylindrical shapes.

items.label: Optimise Details
items.value: Thickened 0.43-inch diameter pipe is more durable for climbing plants; metal-coated plastic pipe is rustproof; extra-resilient connector ensures it won't crack when bent at a 90° angle.

items.label: Easy Installation
items.value: No tools required; it can be assembled in under 10 minutes. The detachable garden trellis is easy to store and saves space. Please refer to the instruction manual for installation steps.

items.label: Stunning Garden Decorations
items.value: Provide decorative accents and height support for roses, clematis, and vines. Suitable for pot diameter Greater than 17 inches
